title: Sum up all items
description: Once for all items: items holds the JSON of every item; the returned array becomes the output items.

parameters.code:
const total = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.amount, 0);
return [{ count: items.length, total }];

title: Change each item, drop some
description: Once per item: $json is the item; return null to drop it.
